actions.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so that telnet 127.0.0.1 6665 connects to a login prompt, and block until the service is ready.
required_artifacts: A running background QEMU process using /app/alpine.iso
required_behaviors: QEMU must remain running in the background
Connecting with telnet to 127.0.0.1 6665 must present a login prompt
The agent must block until readiness is established
known_invalid_patterns: Only verifying that the ISO file exists
Only starting QEMU without confirming the telnet port is ready
Only checking for process existence without service readiness
Treating non-empty output or compile/smoke checks as sufficient
verification_plan: Launch QEMU with host port 6665 forwarded to the guest console/login service
Probe 127.0.0.1:6665 until the login prompt is observed
Keep the QEMU process running in the background after readiness is confirmed
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the QEMU launch command
Receipt-backed evidence that 127.0.0.1:6665 accepted a connection and showed a login prompt
